definition_zh: 祝福；祝祷（文学用语、古雅）
definition_en: a blessing, especially one spoken; a literary or archaic word
core_image: 婚礼上长者向新人抬手说出的古老祝词
scene: 婚礼礼成，长者抬手向新人低声诵出祝词。The village priest gave the young couple his warm benison.
sceneCN: 这里 benison 是「祝福、祝祷」（第 1 个义项：口头说出的祝词）；句意是村中神父向年轻夫妇致以温暖的祝福。

derivatives.zh: 同根常用词，义为「祝福；祝祷」

senses.title: A spoken blessing
senses.definition: words that call down good and favour on someone
senses.definitionCN: 祈求福泽降临于人的话语
senses.example: The village priest gave the young couple his warm benison.
senses.exampleCN: 村中神父向年轻夫妇致以温暖的祝福。
senses.why: Bene means well and the root is dicere, to speak, so it is good speech.
senses.whyCN: bene 意为「好」，词根为 dicere「说」，合起来即「说好话赐福」。

senses.title: A felt blessing or godsend
senses.definition: anything felt as a blessing, especially relief after hardship
senses.definitionCN: 被当作福气的事，尤指苦后的恩惠
senses.example: The cool evening wind was a benison to the tired walkers.
senses.exampleCN: 傍晚的凉风对疲惫的旅人是一份恩赐。
senses.why: Good-speaking widens to any goodness that seems wished upon us.
senses.whyCN: 「说好话赐福」扩大为一切像被祝福降临的好处。

intro.en: Benison is Old French benedicun, from Latin benedictio, a blessing.
intro.cn: benison 来自古法语 benedicun，源自拉丁语 benedictio「祝福」。

items.en: the root deik- meant to point out, to pronounce.
items.cn: 词根 deik- 意为「指出、宣示」（重构形式）。

items.en: benedictio meant a speaking well, a blessing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 benedictio 意为「说好话、祝福」。

items.en: beneiçun or benedicun shortened the Latin phrase.
items.cn: 古法语 beneiçun、benedicun 缩略了拉丁语词形。

items.en: Middle English took benison from the French form.
items.cn: 中古英语十四世纪从法语形式借入 benison。

items.en: it survives as a literary and archaic twin of benediction.
items.cn: 如今作为 benediction 的文学化、古雅孪生词存留。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bene- or dict- roots; the near-meaning group gathers blessing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bene- 或 dict- 词根；近义组汇集祝福类词。

entries.definitionCN: 诅咒——前缀相反的古雅对照词
监狱——拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: a prayer or gift of favour
a formal blessing at a service

entries.definitionCN: 天赐之物；强调意外之喜

normalIntro.en: Benison is an old shortened form of benediction.
normalIntro.cn: benison 是 benediction 的古体缩略。

normal.en: Malison is its opposite, a curse.

normal.cn: 这个词有文学和古雅色彩。

normal.en: Use benediction in daily modern prose.
normal.cn: 现代日常行文多用 benediction。

abstract.en: See old hands raised over young heads.
abstract.cn: 看苍老的手覆向年轻的头顶。

abstract.en: Feel candle warmth on a wedding aisle.
abstract.cn: 感受婚礼通道上的烛光暖意。

abstract.en: Picture evening wind as a soft gift.
abstract.cn: 想象晚风如温柔的赠礼。

examples.en: The village priest gave the young couple his warm benison.
examples.cn: 村中神父向年轻夫妇致以温暖的祝福。

examples.en: The cool evening wind was a benison to the tired walkers.
examples.cn: 傍晚的凉风对疲惫的旅人是一份恩赐。

examples.en: She left with her mother's benison and little else.
examples.cn: 她带着母亲的祝福离开，别无长物。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「杯你神」——举杯敬你、敬神，满口都是祝福之词。

root: 拉丁语 bene「好地」加 dicere「说」，派生 benedictio「祝福」；古法语缩略为 beneiçun、benedicun，中古英语十四世纪借入作 benison，与 benediction 同源异流；反义词 malison「诅咒」以 male「坏」替换 bene「好」。

sensesIntro.en: One archaic noun covers both spoken blessings and the quiet gifts that feel like blessings.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个古雅名词，既指出口成章的祝词，也指像被祝福过的恩惠。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: old hands raised over young heads at a wedding.
core.cn: 核心意象：婚礼上长者之手覆向新人头顶。

branches.en: a benison to the tired walkers

intro.en: Benison keeps the bene- good root in a shortened old shape.
intro.cn: benison 以古老的缩略形保留 bene-「好」词根。

latinIntro.en: It descends from Latin benedictio like benediction.
latinIntro.cn: 它与 benediction 同出拉丁语 benedictio。

latinEntries.meaning: a blessing; common root of benison and benediction
latinEntries.meaningCN: 祝福；benison 与 benediction 的共同词源
